title: Reconnect to the Masculine or Feminine Within You: The Law of Gender Rigidity
coreMove: Recover the disowned assertive or receptive capacity that rigid role performance has made feel forbidden.
sourcePressure: This law is about integration, not stereotype enforcement: rigid gender performance narrows people by splitting assertive and receptive capacities into hostile camps.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Flattening the law into gender stereotypes instead of freeing a fuller range of human traits.

exampleSpecs.audience: a leader whose rigid self-image blocks receptivity

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she stops the briefing and lets the warehouse lead redraw the route, accepting correction without surrendering authority
